entities.name: Leyline
entities.description: Networks of mana paths flowing across the landscape, natural enchantments found rather than cast.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker with an instinctive capacity to understand and manipulate leylines.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker who bent Innistrad's leylines to summon Emrakul and later planned to use the Lithoform Core.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi summoned to Innistrad by Nahiri.

entities.name: Kendrin
entities.description: A researcher who died studying Zendikar's leylines, the Eldrazi, hedrons and the Eye of Ugin.

events.summary: Nahiri summons Emrakul to Innistrad by crafting cryptoliths to bend the leylines.
events.quote: Nahiri took advantage of that fact to summon Emrakul to Innistrad

events.summary: Kendrin dies researching a connection between Zendikar's leylines, the Eldrazi, the hedrons and the Eye of Ugin.
events.quote: Kendrin died while researching a connection between Zendikar 's leylines
